title: NPDev session handoff
description: Where a working session stopped, so the next one resumes without re-deriving it. Written by scripts/ai/Close-Session.ps1 to ledger/session-state/current.json (overwritten each close) and appended to history.jsonl (one object per line, never rewritten).

closedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the session was closed.

head.description: Short SHA of HEAD at close.

summary.description: What the session actually did. One or two sentences.

nextStep.description: The resume point. Must be actionable with no other context: 'Wire the PreToolUse hook into settings.json, then verify with a bare gradlew', not 'continue the roadmap'.

plan.description: Path or URL to the plan or roadmap being followed, if any.

blocked.description: Anything genuinely blocked, and on what. Not 'not done yet'.

verified.description: What verification actually ran -- gate names and results, or 'none'. Never imply verification that did not happen.

dirtyFiles.description: Up to 20 porcelain lines for uncommitted files at close.

unpushed.description: Commits ahead of upstream at close.

landedCommits.description: One-line log of commits made since the previous close -- what this session landed.
